scope: Saved sustained-isolation plants, same investment and capacity, natural visitors versus saturating outcross pollen; no evolutionary rules changed.
exposure: Use visitor snapshot indexed by plant state time; state1000 excluded because the frozen history contains only snapshots0..999.
sampling: All64 histories x8 demographic repeats x2 arms x2 settings x2 mutation rates; validate raw hashes before assays. No outcome-based selection.
saturation: Delayed: all ovules outcross and residual selfing zero. Prior: only ovules not already selfed can outcross; retain prior selfing and its depression.
outputs: raw seed deficit relative to saturated pollen
viable offspring deficit relative to saturated pollen
limits: No resource reallocation, future recruitment or donor feedback. Counterfactual is an instantaneous female-function upper-bound assay, not a full experimental pollen-addition protocol or an estimate of actual Q1 effect size. Zero denominator is undefined. Selfing capacity is not realized selfing. No time-order or causal-mediation claim from three snapshots.
